posts.cooked:
Mostly for my own amusement. These are currently all of the cards from the released expansions with characters on them that do not have their own character or minion card. As >G has shown a tendency to offer sneak peaks of future expansions through the artwork, let's see what we can find.

{Edit} Updated to reflect Shattered TimeLines cards

 

[Edit] Updated to reflect Vengeance cards.

 

[Edit] Updated to reflect Wrath of the Cosmos cards.

 

[Edit] Updated to reflect new information found by Matchstick Man

Ghostly Images – Realms of Discord: Greatest Legacy and GI Bunker

Claustrophobic Delusion – Realms of Discord: Unknown figure in red with gold boots, probably Captain Cosmic.

Blighted Streets - Rook City: Young girl confirmed to be a young Ermine.

Scum and Villainy – Rook City: Friction. Proletariot. Char. Bulky figure at the back that looks like its on fire, probably the Radioactivist.

Maintenance Level – Wagner Mars Base: FrightTrain. Also on Flak Cannon.

Coolant Blast – Absolute Zero: Proletariot. Also appears on Scum and Villainy and Lead from the Front.

Frost Bound Drain – Absolute Zero: Char. Also on Scum and Villainy

Vernal Sonata – Argent Adept: Tempest's dog.

Syncopated Onslaught – Argent Adept: The Aeon Men. Also on Cerebral Haemorhage,

Silver Shadow – Argent Adept: Caprain Cosmic. Prime Wardens Tempest

Polyphoric Flare – Argent Adept: Siege-Breaker

Rhapsody of Vigor – Argent Adept: Confirmed to be the Idealist.

Counterpoint Bulwark – Argent Adept: Grotesque Arachnoid

Incapacitated - Argent Adept, Prime Warden: Tentacled alien elder god with single eyes in the centre.

Flak Cannon – Bunker: FrightTrain. Also on Maintenance Level

Incendiary Rounds – Expatriette: Citizen Slash

Shock Rounds – Expatriette: Revenant. Setback, also on Weak Heart and Violent Trickster.

Quick Draw – Expatriette: Unknown man in shirt with gun. May be Tony Taurus

Hollow Points – Expatriette: Argentium

Sacrosanct Martyr – Fanatic: Illusory Demon

Incpacitated - Fanaticm, Prime Warden: Grey-skinned ghouls/Vampires

Haka of Battle – Haka: The Radioactivist

Elbow Smash – Haka: The Hippo

Back-fist Strike – Legacy: Man in white, apparently with cap flying off. May be on Combat Stance

Incapacitated Side – Legacy: Woman cradling Legacy. Probably his wife, Mrs Parsons.

Lead from the front – Legacy: Proletariot. Appears multiple times. Also appears on Coolant Blast and Scum and Villainy.

Motivational Charge – Legacy: Citizen Anvil.

“Thokk!” - Legacy: Dark Hero

Overdrive – Mister Fixer: Zhu Long

Pipe Wrench – Mister Fixer: Zhu Long

Hoist Chain - Mister Fixer: Granite Oni

Dark Watch Promo - Incapacitated - Mister Fixer: Identified as Heartbreaker in For Profit description.

Call Forth – NightMist: Man-Grove

Heedless Lash – NightMist: The Seer

Mists of Time – NightMist: Cosmic entity holding the Earth

Incapacitated – Tachyon: Figure on ice slide. Figure in whirlwind.

Fleet of Foot – Tachyon: Friction. Also appears on Scum and Villainy.

Lightning Reflexes – Tachyon: Treacherous Ape

Lightspeed Barrage – Tachyon: Giant zombie/Frankenstein Monster with glowing red eyes

Nimble Strike – Tachyon: Female figure with red hair in dark red costume, part of the Slaughterhouse Six

Sucker Punch – Tachyon: Identified from the Hero Challenge acheivements as Biomancer.

Supersonic Repsonse – Tachyon: Writhe.

Synaptic Disruption – Tachyon: Figure surrounded in blue flames.

Flash Flood – Tempest: Giant red male

Incapacitated - Tempest, Prime Warden: Black skinned figure with trident and tentacles for hair.

Volatile Parts – Unity: Giant flaming figure, also on High-Risk Behaviour. Part of the Slaughterhouse Six

Powered Shockwave – Unity: The Radioactivist

Incapacitated – Visionary: Purple figure behind her. Probably Dark Visionary.

Demoralisation – Visionary: Toy Master

Decoy Projection – Visionary: Major Flay

Cerebral Haemorrhage – Visionary: Armoured figures. Also on Syncopated Onslaught

Suggestion – Visionary: Male figure with shaggy fur on shoulders.

Incapacitated – Rook City Wraith: Equity. Short figure in gold. Ermine.

Throat Jab – Wraith: Macabre Spectre

Combat Stance – Wraith: Thug in white with cap. May be on Back-Fist Strike.

Disrupt the Field – Akash'Bhuta: Omnitron-X

Living Rockslide – Akash'Bhuta: Chrono-Ranger. Also appears on Shadowy Ambush.

Shadowy Ambush – Plague Rat: Chrono-Ranger. Also on Living Rockslide.

The Desert's Wrath – The Ennead: Giant Egyptian golem

 

"Dead or Alive", Eye on the Prize, Terrible Tech-Strike - Chrono-Ranger: Doc Tusser

"No Executions" - Chrono-Ranger: Target. Confirmed as Citizen Truth.

"The Whole Gang" - Chrono-Ranger: The Crackjaw Crew.

Defensive Blast - Omnitron-X: The Aeon Men

Demoralizing Presence - Iron Legacy: The Radioactivist. The hulking figure under the rock, sprculated to be Haka as it's similar to the his incapaciated side.

Iron-Fist Strike - Iron Legacy: Mainstay

"Diplomatic" Envoy - Miss Information: Possibly Major Flay, purely on the red arm whips.

"Old Lady" in the Street - Miss Information: Icy female

Isolated Hero - Miss Information: Four characters. Ermine. The Radioactivist. Zhu Long. Vyktor.

Projected Paralysis - The Dreamer: Sky-Scraper,

Vigilance - Iron Legacy: Man and child featured.

Weak Hear - Kismett: Setback

Violent Trickster - Kismet: Setback

 

Energy Burn - Knyfe: Unknown alien with visible glowing brain

Incidental Contact - Knyfe: The Aeon Men

Primed Punch - Knyfe: Unknown monolith, may not be a character.

Naturalist, Incapacitated side: Deadline

Hyperactive Senses - The Naturalist: Masked figure and illusory duplicates, part of the Slaughterhouse Six

Indomitable Force - The Naturalist: Deadline. The Idealist

Shifter's Strength - The Naturalist: Infinitor

Buffer Overflow - Parse: Tryragon Rex

Exploit Vulnerability- Parse: Unknown plant-based member of Crackjaw Crew

Quick Calculation- Parse: Korrupton, the Last Infektor

Reveal the Flaws- Parse: Captain Cosmic, Progeny

Snap Decision- Parse: Blonde woman hostage

Blackout - The Sentinels: Unknown figure in red and blue with gun and silver backpack, probably Riot Ray

Coordinated Assault - The Sentinels: Unknown red giant with green gloves, may be on Flash Flood.

Sentinel Tactics:- Ther Sentinels Two unknown members of the Crackjaw Crew

Cause and Effect - Setback: Unknown shadow creature

High Risk Behaviour- Setback: Unknown electrical villain in black. unknown mirror-masked villainess in orange. unknown stingray villain in blue. unknown winged villain in purple. unknown lava creature. Identified collectively from the Villain Challenge Document as the Slaughterhouse Six.

Plucky Break- Setback. Unknown electrical villain in black

Uncharmed Life- Setback: Unknown mirror-masked villainess in orange. Also appears on Nimble Strike

 

Destructive Response - Captain Cosmic: Multiple aliens with metallic skull faces and glowing brains. Also appears on Energy Burn.

Harsh Offense - Captain Cosmic: Woman with glowing blue eyes.

Wounding Buffer - Captain Cosmic: Horned blue creature firing laser beams from its eyes.

Incapacitated - Captain Cosmic: Giant stone hand

Incapacitated Side - Captain Cosmic, Prime Warden: Woman with pale green skin and red eyes. Similar but not identical appearance to Jansa Vi Dero.

Thorathian Monolith - Sky-Scraper: The Aeon Men

Fickle Fans - Kaargra Warfang: Many aliens

Stone Jaw - Title Deck: Unknown man in suit holding rock. may be Tony Taurus.

The Unbreakable - Title Deck: Two headed creature in sand behind Haka. May be Tryragon Rex, but lacks the three eyes of his individual card.

Thorathian Military - Dok Thorath: Flyign Thorathian female.

Hall of the terminarch - Enclave of the Endlings: Unknown funky Martial Artist. Believed to be Black Fist, Mr Fixer in his younger days.

The Endling Refuge - Enclave of theendlings: Purple cyclopean giant.

Best Card Ever! - Guise: Butler

Gimmicky Character - Guise: The shark

Where Did I Have That ... - Guise: Pool ball themed villain.

 

 

 

Other Notes:

Insider Knowledge shows 20 folders. 

By columns, they are:

  1. Absolute Zero, Argent Adept, Bunker, Chrono-Ranger
  2. Expatriette, Fanatic, Haka, "Knyfe"
  3. Legacy, Mister Fixer, Nightmist, Omnitron X
  4. "Parse", Ra, ?, "Setback"
  5. Tachyon, (Tempest?), Visionary, Wraith

Insider Knowledge infor discovereed by McBehrer


Some of these (particularly the Desert's Wrath) may be reading too much into the images, but any others I've missed? Any on the list that have been confirmed anywhere?

[EDIT] Updated to catch errors.
